blocks.text: Transition metal complexes ki khaas geometries (shakalein) hoti hain jo metal ki electronic configuration, coordination number (jure hue donor atoms ka number) aur ligands ki type par depend karti hain. Aam geometries yeh hain:

items: Linear: do ligands central metal ion ke aamne saamne, 180° ke angle par. Misalein: [Ag(NH₃)₂]Cl aur K[Ag(CN)₂].

Square planar: central metal ion aur chaar ligands ek hi plane mein, square ke konon par, bond angle 90°. Yeh d⁸ metal ions (maslan Ni²⁺, Pt²⁺) ki pehchan hai, NH₃ aur CN⁻ jaise ligands ke saath. Misalein: [Ni(CN)₄]²⁻ aur [Pt(NH₃)₄]²⁺.
Tetrahedral: chaar ligands tetrahedron ke konon par, bond angle 109.5°. Kitab ke mutabiq yeh shakal d⁷, d⁸ aur d¹⁰ configuration wale metal ions mein aam hai; misalein [CoCl₄]²⁻ aur [MnCl₄]²⁻.

Octahedral: central metal ion ke gird chhe ligands, x, y aur z axes par. Chaar ligands 90° par ek square plane banate hain aur baqi do is plane ke upar aur neeche (aapas mein 180°). Yeh transition metal complexes ki sab se aam shakal hai. Misalein: [Cr(NH₃)₆]³⁺ aur [Co(en)₃]³⁺.

blocks.alt: Chaar ball-and-stick models, har aik mein laal metal ion aur hare bonds par neele ligands: Linear (2), do ligands aamne saamne; Square Planar (4), chaar ligands aik plane mein; Tetrahedral (4); Octahedral (6).
blocks.caption: Figure 18.3: Transition metal complexes ki shakalein (kitab ki Figure 18.3 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bracket wala number coordination number hai. Bond angles: linear 180°, square planar 90°, tetrahedral 109.5°, octahedral 90°. Dhyan dein: [MnCl₄]²⁻ mein Mn²⁺ d⁵ hai (Quick Check 18.3 c), phir bhi yeh tetrahedral hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Lewis acid-base concept complex banne ko kaise samjhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Metal ion Lewis acid hai jo khaali d orbitals mein electron pairs leta hai; har ligand Lewis base hai jo lone pair deta hai. Is liye har metal-ligand bond coordinate bond hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Cr³⁺ aur chhe neutral H₂O ligands (coordination number 6) se banne wale complex ka total charge hisaab se nikalein.
c) [MnCl₄]²⁻ ki shakal batayein jab metal ion d⁵ aur coordination number 4 ho.
blocks.explanation: Tetrahedral (bond angle 109.5°); square planar d⁸ ions ki pehchan hai.

blocks.prompt: d) EDTA hexadentate ligand hai. Hexadentate ka coordinate bonds ke lihaz se kya matlab hai?
blocks.explanation: Ek EDTA ion chhe donor atoms (do N aur chaar O) se ek hi metal ion ke saath chhe coordinate covalent bonds banata hai.

blocks.prompt: e) Transition metal ion ki woh do features (khoobiyan) batayein jo use complex ions banane deti hain.
blocks.explanation: (1) Is ke paas khaali (vacant) d orbitals hain jin ki energy itni kam (accessible) hai ke ligands ke lone pairs le sakein. (2) Is ka chhota size aur zyada charge (zyada charge density), jo ligands ke lone pairs ko apni taraf kheenchta hai.

items: 2 ligands: linear (180°); 4: square planar (90°) ya tetrahedral (109.5°); 6: octahedral (90°).
Square planar d⁸ ions jaise Ni²⁺ aur Pt²⁺; octahedral sab se aam.
